items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: He was there when we made some records. He worked at the Nest. He worked there quite a while at the Nest, when we made them records

ctx.x: He was there. He was part of George Howard's band. He was a guitar player.
I see. And what about Bass Moore on tuba? Was he there also?

Well, he was there when we made some records. He worked at the Nest. He worked there quite a while at the Nest, when we made them records, and I told you that was Freddy Jenkins on one of the records playing...
